source: agent-comms/outbox-gpt/GPT-REPORT-014-catalog-and-copy-matrix.md (Edition E01-E13, colecciones y orden manual). Recuentos contrastados con agent-comms/outbox-claude/harness-AUDIT-FINAL-002/results-07-parity-catalog.json (edition: 13 productos, opciones Finish y Size).
pending_data: Estado draft: GPT-REPORT-014 exige verificar antes de activar material (full-grain, vegetable-tanned), forro, composición del metal, cantos, herrajes, ajuste de dispositivos, todas las dimensiones y el acabado fotografiado de cada variante. El plan V4.1 (línea 237) prohíbe mostrar «solid brass» o el tipo como material sin respaldo factual aprobado.
Vendor vacío: Shopify usa el nombre de la tienda. No se inventa marca.
En la tienda sartorial-edition la colección de escritorio tenía el handle desk-study; las plantillas usan desk-and-study (listings/imprint/templates/index.json). Usar desk-and-study.
Precios: propuesta de posicionamiento de GPT-REPORT-014, no tasación.

C-08 (Johandry, 2026-11-02): las descripciones ya no declaran grado o curtido de la piel, metal macizo, acabados a mano ni la evolución del metal con el uso. Lo que queda (piel, latón, medidas, forros) sigue en draft y se verifica antes de activar.
Handle milled-brass-paperweight: el título pasa a Brass Paperweight; el handle se conserva porque lo usan las colecciones. Johandry decide si se renombra antes de importar.
structured-tote también existe en Sartorial: ver D-01-catalogo-y-fotos.md. Imprint conserva el handle porque listings/imprint/templates/index.json lo usa.

products.title: Structured Tote in Calfskin
products.body: Calfskin forms a clean body with a reinforced base, a lined interior and finished edges. Compact measures 30 x 24 x 11 cm; Standard measures 38 x 29 x 13 cm, with an internal slip pocket in each size.

products.title: East-West Shoulder Bag
products.body: A long, low bag in smooth calfskin with a concealed magnetic tab and a cotton-twill lining. The body measures 34 x 18 x 8 cm; one internal zip pocket.

products.title: Compact Crossbody
products.body: Grained calfskin with a detachable strap. The body measures 23 x 16 x 6 cm, with one interior card slot and an adjustable 48-58 cm strap drop.

products.title: Leather Document Folio
products.body: Leather wraps an A4-compatible folio with a fabric-lined divider and a flat pen loop. It measures 34 x 25 x 3 cm.

products.title: Padded Laptop Sleeve
products.body: A padded leather sleeve with an interior of 33 x 23 cm; check the fit against your device. Exterior dimensions are 35 x 25 x 2.5 cm, with a brushed-cotton lining and two-way zip.

products.title: Zip Travel Pouch
products.body: Calfskin with a gusseted base and a cotton lining. It measures 25 x 17 x 5 cm and has one divided interior pocket.

products.title: Slim Bifold Wallet
products.body: A folded leather wallet with six card slots and a full-width note sleeve. Closed dimensions are 11 x 9 x 1.5 cm; edges are finished.

products.title: Four-Slot Cardholder
products.body: A compact calfskin case with four card slots and a central pocket. It measures 10.5 x 7.5 x 0.5 cm.

products.title: Leather Key Loop
products.body: A folded strip of leather holds a single metal split ring with a stitched keeper. The loop measures 12 x 2.5 x 0.4 cm excluding the ring.

products.title: Leather Desk Mat
products.body: A leather surface with a suede-backed underside. Compact measures 45 x 30 x 0.3 cm; Large measures 60 x 35 x 0.3 cm.

products.title: Folded Valet Tray
products.body: Four fastened corners turn leather into a shallow tray for keys, watch and small tools. The usable base measures 18 x 18 cm and the raised edge is 4 cm high.

products.title: Brass Paperweight
products.body: A plain brass disc. It measures 6 cm in diameter and 2 cm high.

products.title: Single Pen Sleeve
products.body: A stitched calfskin sleeve for one writing instrument. Exterior dimensions are 16 x 3 x 1.5 cm; check the pen's circumference before ordering.
